video_title: Malik Beasley Tells N3on The Truth About The NBA...

quotes.speaker: Malik Beasley
quotes.summary_phrase: Malik Beasley on the physical intensity of international versus NBA play
quotes.excerpt: Physicality is different too. It's not as physical into the playoffs for the NBA. Down there it's physical.

text_blocks.speaker: N3on
text_blocks.text: When you're in an intense game, a professional game, in the UFC they say not to drink water. They say to put it in your mouth and gargle it and swirl it around and spit it out. Are you drinking water?

text_blocks.speaker: Malik Beasley
text_blocks.text: I drink half water, half Gatorade because I don't want too many electrolytes in the game. Physicality is different too. It's not as physical into the playoffs for the NBA. Down there it's physical every fucking game. Everyone's locked the fuck in. They got a point to prove.

quotes.speaker: Malik Beasley
quotes.summary_phrase: Malik Beasley on playing through exhaustion in Toronto
quotes.excerpt: I actually got subbed out and they were like no, because I had an amazing game.

text_blocks.speaker: N3on
text_blocks.text: Have you ever been tired as fuck and you need to get subbed out but you know you can't and you're just cooked?

text_blocks.speaker: Malik Beasley
text_blocks.text: I actually got subbed out and they were like no, because I had an amazing game in Toronto. I was like I need to sub and he was like no, keep going. Then there was a free throw and I was like I got to come out.

quotes.speaker: Malik Beasley
quotes.summary_phrase: Malik Beasley on his desire to join a championship-contending team
quotes.excerpt: I want to go to a championship team. I already know there's going to be star players.

text_blocks.speaker: N3on
text_blocks.text: What's your ideal team right now? If you had to get a call from any team you could pick right now, who are you picking?

text_blocks.speaker: Malik Beasley
text_blocks.text: All 30 of them. I'm ready to get back in the league. I want to go to a championship team. I already know there's going to be star players and stuff like that. If I can come off the bench or start, I want to win.

quotes.speaker: Malik Beasley
quotes.summary_phrase: Malik Beasley compares international and NBA competition levels
quotes.excerpt: There's nothing better than NBA players. But in terms of culture and the fans screaming, it was insane.

text_blocks.speaker: N3on
text_blocks.text: What's the difference between playing internationally and playing in the NBA competition-wise, intensity-wise?

text_blocks.speaker: Malik Beasley
text_blocks.text: There's nothing better than NBA players. But in terms of culture and the fans screaming and stuff, it was insane in Puerto Rico. It was almost louder than a playoff game. It was a smaller arena and less fans, so that just shows how much the culture is.
